## findings
1. SOURCE-POLICY RED (RED-P1, XF C2 + F1): symptom — seeded self_pay panel line d7f17166… 129.00 is the base list price; root cause — the correction's unscoped replaced_by makes the self_pay published price panel_price + handling + courier + processing; evidence — `lab_ext_member_rate_correction.overwrite[0].replaced_by`, `initial_state.lab_charges.d7f17166….amount = 129.0`; consequence — in-force price 143.00 ≠ 129.00, the own-category row is not producible as of 2026-09-17; affected — lab.extended.yaml overwrite, task0 seed.
2. SOURCE-POLICY RED (RED-P3): return pack 4.50 charged on top of a kit fee defined as including return shipping; affected — kit rule, kit_return_pack, scored kit_charge.
3. SOURCE-POLICY RED (RED-P4): "draw fee standing" defined gross here and net of billing_error refunds in the sibling rules; after the correction the net reading gives 43.45 instead of 35.98; affected — kit, phlebotomy, reissue rules.
4. SOURCE-POLICY RED (RED-P5): qualifying status read today vs "on its ordered date" in the kit sentence — no second number on this world; charter-global.
5. SOURCE-FACTOR RED (RED-F1, F3, F4, F5, F6): specimen_handling mislabelled; courier / processing / dispatch zone keyed on unreal conditions; older-order and weekend surcharges invented; older-order and prior-credit share one date span (51 days each here); no R6 tagging. Each moves the scored value (table above) — the factors bear weight but are not real ladders; surviving honest factors: 1 of 4 (correction), 1 of 6 (kit).
6. Observations: O1 gendered text in the kit rule/docstring; O2 unused membership_id argument.
